marta.s: Noticing an absence of SCIM deprovision audit entries for a group of EU customers starting around 2024-06-01T14:40Z. Suspect correlation with yesterday's KMS RBAC tighten. Can we triage?

ben.d: I see the hole too. Queue shows webhooks arrived (user._delete / group._remove), but the audit DB has redacted placeholders where encrypted payloads should be.

samir.r: Any KMS client failures? I scanned the encrypt traces during the window and saw multiple AccessDenied for alias lookup.

marta.s: Example log snippet:

```
2024-06-01T14:39:57Z svc-scim-handler INFO webhook received id=wh_eu_001
2024-06-01T14:39:59Z svc-scim-handler ERROR kms_encrypt failed: AccessDenied for alias/rdw-eu-audit-key
2024-06-01T14:39:59Z svc-scim-handler WARN audit_redacted id=wh_eu_001
```

elaine: That lines up with the policy change we pushed that restricted alias ARNs for service roles. Likely the alias pattern for older EU aliases didn't match the new rule.

marta.s: The redact-on-fail behavior is set to keep a placeholder instead of the raw event, which explains the gap. Compliance won't be happy.

oncall: security-bot opened incident INC-2024-067 (sev=2) and paged the oncall rotation.

ben.d: Proposed immediate actions: (A) rollback the recent KMS alias restriction, (B) enable a temporary fallback path that encrypts payloads with a staging key and writes to a secure S3 bucket, (C) run a backfill for the affected time range. Which do we prioritize?

samir.r: We should avoid long-lived plaintext. Fastest fix is (A) minimal rollback to restore alias access for the scim processor principal, then kick off (C). Also implement (B) as a short-lived safety net.

elaine: I can sign an emergency policy revert for the KMS alias filter. Will route for approvals.

marta.s: Two safety checks before reverting: 1) ensure the processor principal still cannot Decrypt the same key, and 2) collect the impacted tenant list for the compliance report.

ben.d: Confirmed: current IAM roles grant Encrypt/GenerateDataKey only; Decrypt is gated to a separate vault principal. For affected tenants, queue sampling shows prefixes eu-old-55, eu-old-102, eu-old-208 — roughly 280 events.

samir.r: Policy diff shows the removed line limited aliases to `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:alias/rdw-*`. Without it the KMS SDK can't resolve alias ARNs to key IDs. Reinstating that stanza should restore normal behavior.

elaine: Approval request created (link: https://internal/approvals/3456). ETA for approvers ~10m.

marta.s: In parallel, can we change redact-on-fail to write the raw webhook encrypted with a fallback staging key to S3 instead of placeholder text? That preserves payloads without relying on the primary alias.

ben.d: I can push a small config change to toggle redact->backup-s3. The code path already supports a fallback KMS key `arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/fallback-stage-02`. Will coordinate IAM for the role to use that key.

samir.r: Note for vuln triage: I found a few webhook bodies containing temporary API tokens in a debug field. We must scrub or rotate those before any external handoff/backfill. Add token-scrub to the backfill pipeline.

marta.s: Good point. Action item: rotate affected tokens and include a scrub step in backfill.

security-bot: Approval granted by @security-lead. Applying policy revert now.

oncall: Policy revert applied at 2024-06-01T14:51:30Z. Alias resolution retested.

ben.d: svc-scim-handler retried failed payloads and encrypt calls now succeed. Audit rows are being written again. I started backfill job (id: backfill-20240601-01).

marta.s: Backfill stats: processed 284 events, scrubbed 9 token values, uploaded encrypted archive to s3://sec-backfill/prod/eu/2024-06-01/backfill-20240601-01.enc, SHA256 checksum matched.

samir.r: Follow-ups: (1) add a CI lint to catch alias ARN regressions in future policy changes, (2) create an alert for KMS alias resolution errors if >0.5% of encrypts fail over 5m, (3) update the incident runbook to mention fallback-stage-key pattern and backfill scrubbing.

marta.s: I'll draft the compliance memo and update the runbook. Ben and Samir, please add the CI/alert tasks to the security backlog and mark as P2.

ben.d: Created PRs for CI linting and backfill scrub rules.

elaine: Closing the incident after compliance confirms receipt of backfill proof. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

security-bot: INC-2024-067 status -> monitoring
